notes: Deterministic checks evaluated by scripts/run_acceptance.py score() against a run's out_dir: transcript.jsonl (stream-json), rounds.jsonl, provider-spend.json and artifacts/ (files copied from the eval project directories only). proxy=true means the check tests presence or a countable stand-in, not the quality judgement in the title; those need the blinded review in Task 7.3. Artifact names follow the plan (Tasks 3.9, 4.3, 4.4, 5.1, 5.3, 6.4); a tree without those capabilities is expected to fail them.

checkpoints.title: Workspace check offers the existing german-insurance-opportunity workspace before creating anything
checkpoints.pass_rule: An assistant message names german-insurance-opportunity before the first tool call that creates or writes anything under projects/. Invocations with --help or -h are read-only and do not count as writes.

checkpoints.title: Routing reaches idea-grill without an envelope denial; hook denials are counted
checkpoints.pass_rule: A successful route_workflow.py result naming idea-grill (not a usage/argparse failure), idea-grill loaded by a non-denied Skill call or a read of its SKILL.md, and zero hook denials of idea-grill. flags.skill_tool_bypassed reports (without failing) a read-only load, which also skips the Skill hook's injected route context. All hook denials are counted in the scorecard's hook_denials.

checkpoints.title: Intake asks at most one decision-changing question per turn and persists answers
checkpoints.pass_rule: Proxy: every assistant turn that the feeder answered ends with at most one question sentence ('?'), and at least half of the fed founder answers that carry persist_markers appear in an eval-project artifact.

checkpoints.title: Topic-led VOC and entity-led feedback run as separate frames; entity-led covers at least three verified competitors discovered by the run
checkpoints.pass_rule: Evidence records exist with sampling_frame topic_led_voc and, separately, entity_led_feedback; entity-led records cover at least three distinct subject_entity_id values. Proxy: verification status of the entities is not re-checked.

checkpoints.title: Search-journey study runs on German-language queries across at least four journey stages and reports ads separately from organic
checkpoints.pass_rule: A serp-landscape.json with at least four stages, a plan or capture with journey_stage rows in language de, and captures carrying ads_status separately from organic results.

checkpoints.title: Official statistics and the §34d versus §34e GewO distinction are surfaced with sources
checkpoints.pass_rule: Proxy: one of the agent's own documents (a top-level assistant round or an authored artifact; collected provider data excluded) mentions both §34d and §34e with a URL; one cites a statute or regulator source (gesetze-im-internet.de, bafin.de, an IHK/DIHK domain, vermittlerregister.info); and one line cites an official statistic, meaning a number with a unit on the same line as an official source (Destatis, Eurostat, GDV statistics, Bundesbank, BMG, GKV-Spitzenverband, BAS, PKV-Verband); a bare domain in a list of ranking domains does not count. The URL scheme is optional for the domain checks. The two source sub-checks are reported separately in sub_checks. Accuracy is graded in Task 7.3.

checkpoints.title: International precedent pass names at least one foreign comparable with verified outcome or explains inapplicability
checkpoints.pass_rule: Proxy: one of the agent's own documents (top-level assistant text or an authored artifact; subagent text and collected provider data such as runs/, raw/, provider-checkpoints/, summaries and *.jsonl are excluded) has one line (a sentence or table row) that combines precedent/international/analog language, a named foreign country and a URL or domain path, without gap language on that line (not checked, unverified, to be researched, unknown, could not, failed, none found, no ... found, TODO, TBD, planned); the country must be a whole word and a domain path must not be a local file path such as notes.md/x; or explicitly states that international precedents do not apply. Outcome verification is graded in Task 7.3.

checkpoints.title: Falsification runs on the claim ledger; decision memo and scores exist; delivery validation passes or the gap is stated
checkpoints.pass_rule: A falsification artifact or apply_falsification call, a decision_memo.md and a scores.json in the eval project, and either a successful validate_research_completion.py --check delivery call or a stated delivery gap.

checkpoints.title: The pain-first gate blocks GTM until problem_validation passes; an explicit override is recorded before downstream stages run
checkpoints.pass_rule: The pain-first gate specifically was blocked (route_workflow result with gate_blocked true and gate pain_first, or a Skill denial naming pain-first/problem_validation) before a route_workflow --override-gate call whose result records gate_override true (a usage/argparse failure does not count); no downstream skill call and no GTM/website/campaign artifact write happened before the override; after it a downstream GTM/marketing/website skill was loaded (Skill tool call or a read of its SKILL.md) and a GTM/website/campaign artifact was then written.

checkpoints.title: GTM, keyword map with volumes, a locally built validation page passing the site gate, and a first-campaign runbook with a paused, unsent campaign draft
checkpoints.pass_rule: All of: a GTM artifact, a keyword map with numeric volume, a local website build, a passing site-gate result, a runbook, a campaign JSON with status paused, and no send/publish/deploy tool call.

checkpoints.title: Provider coverage gaps are reported as gaps, never as absence of demand
checkpoints.pass_rule: Proxy: if any provider failed in a run summary, an assistant round names a coverage gap; and no assistant round claims absence of demand/interest/need. Provider failures come from run summaries and from quota/402 tool results. With no assistant round, no failure evidence source or no observed provider failure the checkpoint is not_exercised (not passed).
